{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A soft wool-blend crewneck sweater in charcoal grey (#36454F) with a relaxed, slightly dropped-shoulder silhouette and ribbed cuffs.
Dark navy straight-leg denim jeans with a mid-rise waist and clean stitching throughout.
Minimalist leather ankle boots in black (#000000) featuring a low block heel and a sleek pointed toe.
This outfit works because it balances professional polish with the comfort needed for a full workday in autumn weather. The charcoal sweater adds visual depth against the crisp navy denim, while the black boots ground the look appropriately for an office setting. It adheres strictly to your preference for everyday wear without any outer layers, as the temperature is expected to be warm enough."}
